rows.text: stores dword 0 at `[rcx]`, then follows the chain from qword `+0x18` through each node's qword `+0x48` until null, storing byte 0 at the first byte of every node

when dword `+0x448` of `rcx` is non-zero calls the callee at `003E69A0` + 0x13 with it in `ecx`; then, when dword `+0x44C` is non-zero, tail-jumps the same callee (`003E69A0` + 0x27) with it in `ecx`, else returns
